svg.title: Expanding the represented activity gas now gives the finite transport expression. At each dictionary key choose either its old scalar contribution or one marked leaf; the ticket condition is that no two chosen leaves use the same key. Each term is the old unselected activity product multiplied by the chosen marked ingredients. The polynomial normalization of each marked leaf is exact: its positive fee times its normalized monomial is its original charge times its marker monomial and leaf bound. Thus no division by a zero total coefficient occurs. The original activity series is absolutely summable under the lawful-activity bounds; only finitely many keys receive marked perturbations. Their sum is still absolutely summable, so regrouping by barcodes and interchanging the finite ticket sum with the activity series are legitimate. The result is exactly the restored fine density with the scalar displacement factored out as Exp P ve{v}νv.
